title: Biased or Not?: The Story of Two Search Engines
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured sentiment bias (liberal vs. conservative viewpoint) in search engine result pages for controversial topics, which included socio-political topics related to religion such as 'Churches and Taxes' and 'Under God in the Pledge'.
findings: The paper did not provide specific findings for religious topics alone. The general finding was that both Google and Bing returned biased results for a set of controversial queries (which included topics like 'Churches and Taxes' and 'Under God in the Pledge'). Both search engines exhibited a similar bias, suggesting the source of bias is likely the underlying web corpus (input bias) rather than the ranking algorithms themselves.
